answer: Handoff chains make a farm serialize every fake. Each epoch the atlas publishes a random order of rewarded keys. A key claims only after the prior key posts a violet, a one-use signed ticket naming the next address. Tickets sit in the orchard, a public wait queue; a forged or reused violet drops that key and freezes its reward for 10 epochs, so skipping also burns the payout. At 8 seconds per handoff, 1,000 fakes need about 2.2 hours of continuous live keys with no parallel claim. Attacker pays 1,000 distinct live sessions for that chain, about $180 in concurrent inference this epoch.
